title: Rounded vowels: /ʊ/ and /u/
goal: Practise /ʊ/ and /u/ and use it in a short, understandable exchange.
cue: For /u/, the tongue is higher; for /ʊ/, it is more relaxed and lower. Lip rounding and tongue position vary naturally. Do not rely only on duration.
spelling: oo has different pronunciations in food and good. Learn the sound with the word.
task: Ask about a pool and explain whether it is full.
story: The pool is full. Ben pulls a chair into the shade.
storyQuestion: Is the pool empty or full?
